mission.name: idea-garnet-l0-evidence-durability
mission.tagline: Lane 0 evidence and changed-path verification must remain deterministic in fresh Windows and Unix clones without hidden
mission.northStar: A fresh Windows clone with default core.autocrlf passes the Lane 0 closeout gate without fetching pull-request refs; A fresh macOS or Linux clone passes the same gate without fetching pull-request refs; Every Lane 0 evidence worktree byte hash equals its authoritative Git object hash on both platforms

policies.notes: review until dogfood band 5 is routine; then auto.

phases.title: Checkout-fidelity repair
phases.goal: Protect every ops lane evidence directory from platform newline conversion while preserving committed object bytes.

gates.title: Lane 0 closeout regression suite passes
gates.notes: Final hardened suite passed 36 tests with one expected Windows symlink skip.

gates.title: Evidence attributes resolve byte-exact
gates.notes: Current and future lane evidence paths resolve text: unset; Windows bytes matched 23/23 Git objects.

phases.title: Main-reachable changed-path proof
phases.goal: Preserve candidate provenance while deriving changed-path content proof only from the landed commit and base on upstream main.

gates.title: Changed-path regression suite passes
gates.notes: Pre-squash object absence, wrong landed count, wrong companion path, and missing origin/main all fail as specified.

gates.title: Lane 0 closeout gate passes without pull refs
gates.notes: Fresh Ubuntu clone passed with no candidate object and no refs/pull/*.

phases.title: Clean-clone and trust closeout
phases.goal: Capture fresh Windows and Unix clone proofs, verify the trust-kernel companion, and prepare one human-merged repair PR.

gates.title: Trust-kernel companion gate passes
gates.notes: Rolling trust-kernel status is ok: true with problems: [].

gates.title: Lane 0 closeout gate passes in this clean clone
gates.notes: Fresh Windows default-autocrlf clone passed with 23/23 byte equality and candidate absent.

gates.title: Repository diff has no whitespace errors

risks.title: A superficially green repair could still depend on an ambient Git object or silently weaken the sealed evidence proof.
U-20 Windows checkout fidelity — RESOLVED
risks.note: Fresh Windows default-autocrlf and Ubuntu clones each proved 23/23 object/worktree byte equality.

risks.title: U-21 discarded pre-squash object dependency — RESOLVED
risks.note: The gate uses only origin/main first-parent base..merged_commit content; candidate provenance is checked without reading its object.

nextActions: Jon reviews and human-merges the repair PR after all live required checks are green.
After merge, Lane 1, Lane 2A follow-on, and Lane 2B re-run the Lane 0 boot gate from fresh upstream main clones before resuming.
conventions: One task = one branch = one PR
Update state.json + render + commit after every merge

closeout.bandCapReason: The repair's three claims are verified, but Garnet launch remains globally capped at band 3 while U-17 and the frozen browser, Shelf, WV, and Lane 2C evidence gaps remain open.
